title: The Corridor Is Built. Now It Needs Freight.
excerpt: Two weeks after the Nordic-African Summit at TechBBQ 2026, the talking points have settled. What remains is a question of traffic — and the freight the corridor is missing sits in the middle, between a promising project and a bankable one.

title: The Number That Followed Me Home From Copenhagen
excerpt: Two weeks after TechBBQ's Investor Day, one number won't leave me: Europe puts roughly 150× less into its own technology than America does. And everything Europe said about itself that afternoon, Africa can say about Europe.
